## Acceptance criteria

Drafted from the design, no ticket rows:

- [ ] Importing a record whose ID is empty is rejected with the invalid-ID error.
  in-scope
- [ ] Importing a record whose ID contains only spaces is rejected with the same invalid-ID error.
  in-scope
- [ ] Importing a record whose ID contains a slash is rejected with the same invalid-ID error.
  in-scope

Nothing has been written. Each malformed-ID case has its own row so it can be checked separately. The rows share the one invalid-ID error, matching the single validation constraint in the design. Approval at the review gate ratifies these drafted rows.
